summary: Resume released canonical leases through protected handoff (NP-053)

delivery.outcome: Resume the same released local canonical ticket through an independently authenticated controller handoff, preserving work and advancing fencing without timeout takeover.
nonGoals: No consumer lease mutation before published independent approval
No idle-policy change, foreign cleanup, source replay or product implementation
No approval or authority from request fields or FD JSON

architecture.decision: Reuse the existing anchored owner-handoff transaction with a separate closed released-resume schema/API and journal namespace. Require actual protected old-writer release/stopped proof bound to exact canonical root/repository, same relative Git worktree, full index/content/intent and scope, legacy basename mapping only to exact canonical origin. Resume claimed with a fresh bounded session; preserve birth plan/scope and dirty files. Reauthenticate exact replay and refuse known completed delivery.
interfaceChanges: Protected resume_released API and closed request schema

dataChanges.description: Exclusive replay journal and canonical monotonic successor lease

architecture.rollback: Revert via independently reviewed ticket; keep journals and old lease snapshots for recovery, never restore a stale fence.

validation.evidence: Adversarial real-Git controller tests including old/new mode isolation, legacy identity, exact CAS/race/replay and proof revocation
Qualified full suite, exact-base governance, native Linux/Windows and protected current-head review
